name: Agroforestry 2025
programme: VLAIO (Flemish Agency for Innovation and Entrepreneurship)
description:
The AGROFORESTRY 2025 project aimed to increase the applicability and economic viability of agroforestry within the Flemish agricultural sector. Through participatory research and collaboration with farmers and other stakeholders, the project developed and optimized agroforestry systems at field and farm level, while exploring feasible financing and revenue models.

Research addressed the contribution of agroforestry to climate change mitigation and adaptation, the selection of suitable tree and crop species and varieties, improved management practices, carbon sequestration potential, biodiversity and ecosystem services. Nine participatory action labs brought together farmers and other value-chain actors to co-develop practical solutions and identify pathways for successful agroforestry adoption.

The project also investigated farm-level profitability, costs and benefits, value-chain opportunities and institutional barriers, producing practical recommendations and best practices to support the implementation and scaling-up of agroforestry systems.
